summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by C3is Inc., a foreign private issuer, furnishing proxy materials for its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders. The agenda includes routine items: election of directors, ratification of auditors, and approval of a reverse stock split authorization. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. The filing is a standard proxy solicitation for an annual meeting, not a special situation under the defined categories.
